Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Plans for a 1987 national gay demonstration in Washington, DC 2. California, gathering support in Hollywood against the LaRouche AIDS quarantine referendum 3. Former President Jimmy Carter tells Jerry Falwell to "go to hell" 4. Andy Humm on President Reagan's silence regarding AIDS health crisis COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 5. Radio for Europe announcer names New York City mayor Ed Koch and San Francisco mayor Diane Feinstein as homosexuals 6. Pentagon announces expansion of HIV antibody testing program to include students enrolled in ROTC programs 7. CDC research program on AIDS delayed due to in-fighting amongst researchers 8. Failure of experimental vaccine to protect against AIDS-like infection in simians COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 9. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: Vivian Shapiro for the Human Rights Campaign Fund 10. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Clips of Cincinnati's drag performer, Hurricane Sommers COMMERCIAL: Gay Cable Network fundraiser 3.Excerpt from Phil Donahue's "Human Animal" on gays in America and coming out 4. Interview with J. D. Slater, gay porn director and actor COMMERCIAL: "Woman Talk" theater piece COMMERCIAL: Body Mate exercise equipment 5. Continuation of interview with director Derek Jarman 6. Closing credits
